outcome: delivery of recognised care pathways (acute LC, access to cholangiogram/ERCP, day-case LC provision)
cohort: 101 paediatric patients (median age 12.9 years) who underwent laparoscopic cholecystectomy at a single institution between January 2009 and January 2019.
finding: The study reported good outcomes from laparoscopic cholecystectomy in children and demonstrated the capacity to deliver recognized standards of care within a paediatric setting.
